Analysis. Weight reductions by means other than CID reductions was discussed in the draft EIS for GM.

For Ford, however, only weight reduction for CID reduction was mentioned. NHTSA agrees that fuel economy standards for future years will be based on a higher degree of aluminum and plastics substitutions.
Priefit/Cost Analysis
Ford Motor Company. Ford stated that their comments on the benefit/cost analysis in the preamble to the NPRM are applicable as a comment to the draft EIS.
<u>Analysis</u>. The cost/benefit relation of the AFES is not an issue in the EIS. An analysis of Ford's comments on the cost/benefit analysis is included in the preamble to the final rule.
Alternative to the Proposed Action
American Motors Corporation (AMC). AMC had several comments on the alternatives to the AFES as discussed in the draft EIS. With regard to the alternative of taking no action, AMC commented that NHTSA did not address the requirements established by Congress to set standards based on (1) technological feasibility, (2) economic practicability, (3) the effect of other Federal motor vehicle standards on fuel economy and (4) the need of the nation
